builtInBundle.adapterNeedsSetup.en: Pick an adapter this coach can run on.
builtInBundle.adapterNeedsSetup.zh-CN: 请选择此教练可使用的适配器。

builtInBundle.adapterPendingApproval.en: Waiting on board hire approval before this coach can run.
builtInBundle.adapterPendingApproval.zh-CN: 此教练需要等待董事会批准雇用后才能运行。

builtInBundle.disableScheduleBody.en: Paperclip CN will stop future scheduled Reflection Coach runs. Manual Run once remains available.
builtInBundle.disableScheduleBody.zh-CN: Paperclip CN 将停止未来的 Reflection Coach 计划运行，但仍可手动运行一次。

builtInBundle.drift.missing.en: Not materialized yet - recreate it from the shipped default.
builtInBundle.drift.missing.zh-CN: 尚未生成，请根据随附默认值重新创建。

builtInBundle.drift.operatorModified.en: You've edited this. Your changes are kept until you reset.
builtInBundle.drift.operatorModified.zh-CN: 你已编辑此资源。重置前会保留这些更改。

builtInBundle.drift.updateAvailable.en: Paperclip CN shipped a newer default.
builtInBundle.drift.updateAvailable.zh-CN: Paperclip CN 已提供更新的默认版本。

builtInBundle.enableScheduleBody.en: Paperclip CN will allow Reflection Coach to create routine tasks on the weekly schedule. It can spend tokens when those tasks run.
builtInBundle.enableScheduleBody.zh-CN: Paperclip CN 将允许 Reflection Coach 按每周计划创建例行任务；这些任务运行时可能消耗词元。

builtInBundle.proposalDetail.en: A proposed Reflection Coach update is waiting for review.
builtInBundle.proposalDetail.zh-CN: 一项 Reflection Coach 更新提案正在等待审核。

builtInBundle.recreateBody.en: This resource is missing. Paperclip CN will recreate it from the shipped default. Adapter credentials and settings are not touched.
builtInBundle.recreateBody.zh-CN: 此资源缺失。Paperclip CN 将根据随附默认值重新创建，且不会更改适配器凭据和设置。

builtInBundle.resetBody.en: This replaces your edited version with Paperclip CN's current default. Your edits can't be recovered. Adapter credentials and settings are not touched.
builtInBundle.resetBody.zh-CN: 这会用 Paperclip CN 当前默认版本替换你编辑的版本，且无法恢复这些编辑。适配器凭据和设置不会被更改。

builtInBundle.runOnceBody.en: Paperclip CN will create one routine task now. This does not enable the weekly schedule or turn on background work.
builtInBundle.runOnceBody.zh-CN: Paperclip CN 现在会创建一个例行任务，但不会启用每周计划或后台工作。

builtInBundle.scheduleDisabledDetail.en: Nothing runs until you enable the weekly schedule - it costs zero tokens by default.
builtInBundle.scheduleDisabledDetail.zh-CN: 启用每周计划前不会运行任何内容，默认不消耗词元。

builtInBundle.scheduleEnabledDetail.en: The weekly schedule is enabled and can create background work.
builtInBundle.scheduleEnabledDetail.zh-CN: 每周计划已启用，可以创建后台工作。

builtInBundle.updateBody.en: You haven't edited this, so Paperclip CN will replace it with the newer shipped version. Nothing you customized is affected, and your adapter credentials and settings are not touched.
builtInBundle.updateBody.zh-CN: 你尚未编辑此资源，因此 Paperclip CN 会将其替换为更新的随附版本。自定义内容、适配器凭据和设置都不会受到影响。
